title: PYP EAL teacher
description: Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna. Welcome to ISSRAre you an experienced and internationally minded English as an additional language teacher who is looking for an opportunity to be a part of the International School of the Stockholm region (ISSR) professional team? ISSR is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) school which offers four IB programmes. The school is a Stockholms stad school and was founded to primarily serve the educational needs of the transient community of Stockholm. ISSR has around 700 students, spanning from 6–19-year-olds and as such provide a coherent education across the IB continuum.ISSR is built on an atmosphere where intellectual growth, personal reflection and international mindedness are the core concerns. Our primary goal is to prepare our students for higher education as we also prepare them for life.Our students are inspired to take intellectual risks through the academically rigorous International Baccalaureate programmes – a pathway to top universities worldwide – nurturing creative critical thinkers empowered to help make our world a better place.Read more about our school: https://internationalschoolofthestockholmregion.stockholmYour RoleAs an English as an Additional language teacher at ISSR, your position includes teaching English as an Additional language to students in grades 1-8, with most of the teaching taking place in the Primary Years Programme (grades 1-5). This position requires flexibility and strong collaboration skills. You are an active member of the PYP team and the language acquisition subject group. All teaching, learning and assessment is based on the International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) curricula. The position is temporary January 11 – June 18, 2027 and it is a full-time position.Other responsibilities are:    Map the EAL needs    Teach EAL students according to student needs    Provide support to all EAL students in mainstream classrooms through push-in and pull-out sessions    Monitor and document the progress of EAL students    Support teachers in providing the best possible learning environment and experiences for EAL students    Collaborate with parents on how to support EAL learning    Plan and collaborate with colleagues across the school    Participate in school activities (assemblies, evening events, conferences, etc.)    On-going professional development Your competence and experienceA successful candidate is certified for and has experience to teach English as an additional language within the IB framework. You have a strong understanding and application of inquiry and concept-based teaching. We are looking for a teacher who has high expectations of the students and brings out the best in every student.As an applicant, you must:    be a certified English as an additional language teacher for primary and/or secondary school students    have a professional level of written and spoken EnglishOther qualifications might also include    documented PYP/MYP IB working experience/ training    experience working as an English teacher in a school setting. You have a strong ability to design teaching, learning and assessment in accordance with IB curriculum. You take responsibility for and have insight into the students' needs, and structure and adapt your teaching so that a safe and learning environment is created.  You are calm, have self-awareness and are a confident leader in the classroom. You value and create a productive working environment for your students. You put strong emphasis on collaboration and foster good relationships with students, parents and colleagues. You plan, organize, prioritize and analyze your lesson planning as well as other assignments that are part of your role in an efficient way.We place major emphasis on personal competence and suitability for the role.MiscellaneousISSR is strongly committed to professional development with a focus on IB workshops and trainings. As an employee in Stockholms stad you get a yearly health stipend.Visit https://pedagog.stockholm/ for more information about what it is like to be a teacher in Stockholms stad.The City of Stockholm works with competence-based recruitment that aims to ensure each person's competence and thus counteract discrimination. - heltid/ full-time- vikariat/ substitute from 11 January– 18 June 2027, with possibility of an extension.-Start date: 11 January, 2027- Contact person: Justina Soewarso SundströmStockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få lämna relevanta betyg och intyg samt, om aktuellt, ett registerutdrag från Polisen. Ladda inte upp detta i samband med att du ansöker.För att arbeta på våra skolor krävs att du uppvisar giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister och misstankeregister innan erbjudande av anställning.Inom Utbildningsförvaltningen tillämpar vi individuell lönesättning reglerat av HÖK och Allmänna Bestämmelser (AB).

title: Tech Support Specialist
description: Reports to: Head of TechnologyDepartment: Technology (IT Operations and Educational Technology)About SISStockholm International School is a truly international K-12 school located in the heart of the dynamic city of Stockholm. We are the first choice for the globally mobile diplomatic, business and research community in Sweden. Our students represent more than 60 countries and our diverse community is made up of over 80% international students and teaching staff. Our language of learning is English but our outlook is global.Job OverviewStockholm International School is seeking a Tech Support Specialist to join our dynamic IT Team and empower all SIS employees and students to do their best work. You will focus on removing technical barriers to productivity and learning  and finding creative solutions to new challenges. The IT Team at SIS is a flexible and agile team, responsible for a wide variety of services and processes and you will play a key role in removing technical barriers and delivering high-quality services to SIS employees and students. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing IT infrastructure, including managing a variety of cloud-based networking solutions, while ensuring the smooth daily operation of all IT systems. Your contributions will directly impact the learning experience at Stockholm International School, empowering students and staff through technology-driven solutions.Duties/responsibilities    Manage, and maintain the school's cloud-based network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, stability, and security for both wired and wireless networks across the campus.    Troubleshoot network, infrastructure and hardware issues proactively, preventing downtime and ensuring the network runs smoothly.     Leverage network automation tools to monitor and resolve issues before they impact users.    Assist in implementing and managing network security protocols.    Ensure the school’s digital environment adheres to secure networking best practices.    Leverage automation tools and network management solutions, to address potential issues and streamline IT operations.    Install, configure, and maintain a variety of devices (macOS, ChromeOS, Windows, iOS) across the network.     Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform, to streamline device deployments and ensure compliance with security policies.    Provide prompt, friendly, and effective support to students, teachers, and staff for their IT needs, ensuring technology enhances the learning and/or working experience.    Help teachers integrate technology into their classrooms by assisting with device setup (such as interactive displays, projectors, and mobile devices).    Offer student tech support, including assistance with educational devices (iPads, Chromebooks, Macbooks) and applications used in learning, such as Google Workspace and classroom-specific tools.    Assist in maintaining and troubleshooting IT resources for school events, such as assemblies, ensuring that audio-visual and conferencing systems work seamlessly.    Organize and run IT support drop-in sessions (Tech Bar) where students and staff can get help for technical issues or receive training on school systems and software.    Provide technical support for school events, including evening and weekend activities, as needed.Qualifications, Attributes and Experience     You have experience supporting macOS, ChromeOS, and Windows-based systems and enjoy providing personal support to help users solve technical problems.    You are familiar with network management tools, including Cisco Meraki or similar cloud-based networking platforms.    You have a basic understanding of Linux and have exposure to scripting and terminal use.    You are familiar with Mobile Device Management platforms.    You articulate yourself well in English, vocally and in writing    You have strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset and are able to work independently and collaboratively.    You are a curious person and a fast learner. You enjoy diving into new technologies and tools.    You have a degree or diploma (Yrkeshögskolan or equivalent) in computer science, management information systems, engineering, or a related field.    You are sensitive to cultural differences and eager to work in a diverse, multicultural environment.    You are able to prioritise and manage multiple cases effectively in a fast-paced environment.Bonus points for    Experience working in a fast-paced school environment    Experience with Google Workplace, Jamf Pro and other applicable cloud services    Understanding of secure networking best practices    Working knowledge of Swedish.Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed, in line with the role and the needs of the organisation.At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.What we offerAs well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of: a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. ContractPermanent Administrative Position (with  six-month probationary period)Employment Rate: 100%Start Date: 11 January 2027SalaryIndividually negotiatedApplicationLast day for applications: November 30, 2026.We only accept applications in English and from qualified candidates.Please send a letter of interest and your CV to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Tech Support Specialist”.Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen.SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position.

title: Researcher in plant breeding, genomics, and sensory and nutritional quality
description: Department of Plant BreedingWe are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in genetics, genomics and crop improvementAbout the positionThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.The candidate will lead experimental and analytical work within the subject and collaborate with other researchers and students in the group as well as outside the organisation.The work will include:    Analyse Genotyping by sequencing (GBS) data (quality control, read mapping and SNP calling)    Genome-wide association studies (GWAS)    Field evaluation and phenotyping of diverse germplasm    Data analysis, interpretation, and preparation of scientific publications within the subject    Participate in collaborative research activities and supervision of students    Apply for external research fundingYour profileQualification requirementsThe following qualifications are required:    A PhD in plant genetics, plant breeding, agriculture, or a related field    Good understanding of the genetic basis of complex quantitative traits    Experience with GBS data and GWAS    Experience with nutritional quality traits in crops    Experience with metabolomic and ionomic profiling including the integration and analysis of multi-omics datasets    Experience with advanced statistical methods for analysing genetic and phenotypic data    Practical experience with field experiments, data collection and phenotyping    Good skills in the programming language R or a comparable language    Very good written and oral English skillsThe candidate must be able to take a leading role in research development as well as to collaborate in research groups and have good overall communication skills.Additional qualificationsThe following qualifications are meritorious:    Experience in plant pathology and/or plant physiology    Machine learning, artificial intelligence or other data-driven approaches to biological datasetsAssessment criteriaAssessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in field phenotyping and analysis of genetic data.The evaluation will also consider the applicant’s ability to conduct independent research, collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment, and communicate scientific results through publications and presentations.About usThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/vf_en/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:AlnarpForm of employment:Permanent positionScope:100%Start date:2027-02-01 or as agreedApplication:Please submit your application before deadline 24 of November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery
description: Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgiVi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!Program DescriptionThe department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers a 6-month fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery. Uppsala is one of the more active units in reconstructive microsurgery in northern Europe with a case load consisting of more than 120 free flaps, 50 complex non microvascular cases in the areas of head and neck reconstruction, breast reconstruction, facial paralysis, lower extremity and complex wound care and more than 50 lymphaticovenous operations per year. The free flap service includes head and neck reconstructions, lower extremity, facial palsy, breast and lymphoedema. The fellowship program is endorsed by the Swedish Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery.Fellowship ResponsibilitiesThe fellow will work in a team of specialists and residents and will participate in the planning and execution of the reconstructive cases performed by the team. The fellow will participate in all teaching activities in the department and will be responsible for around one monthly presentation.The fellow is required to undertake one research project within microsurgery and is expected to finish one publication.SalaryCompetitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.RequirementsThe candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or finish a training program in plastic surgery and have an ambition to pursue a career in reconstructive microsurgery and be able to work in a team.How to applySubmit your CV and two letters of recommendation.ContactAndres Rodriguez, andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se (andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se)Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95Vill du jobba med oss?Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Sub-regional Procurement Category Manager
description: Great procurement goes beyond negotiating a better price. It connects business needs, supplier expertise and market insight to create lasting value. Ready to put that into practice across an international manufacturing business?At DS Smith, we are looking for a Sub-Regional Procurement Category Manager to develop and implement procurement strategies across manufacturing, commodities and pallets in North & East EMEA. You will help shape a competitive and sustainable supply base that supports our packaging operations, innovation and business growth.About the roleYou will shape and deliver procurement strategies for manufacturing, commodities and pallets across North & East EMEA. Reporting to the Sub-Regional Procurement Lead East & North EMEA, you will work with local and global procurement colleagues, Operations and Engineering to lead sourcing, negotiations and supplier partnerships across manufacturing inputs, maintenance services and capital equipment.Combining international category responsibility with practical impact at site level, you will improve cost, working capital, supplier performance and resilience while supporting innovation and sustainability. This is an opportunity to influence how we source the materials, equipment and services our manufacturing sites rely on.The role will be based at one of our offices or sites in Sweden or Denmark, with travel of up to 30%. Posible locations: Värnamo, Mariestad or Gothenburg, in Sverige; Grenaa or Taastrup, in Denmark.About youYou bring procurement category management experience within manufacturing or packaging, including category strategy, complex sourcing and negotiations. Commercially minded and analytical, you turn market insight into practical solutions and build strong relationships across functions and countries to deliver results.You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification and are fluent in English as well as Swedish or Danish. Experience with SAP and Coupa, additional European languages, and CIPS or an equivalent procurement qualification would be advantageous.About usDS Smith is a leading provider of sustainable fiber-based packaging worldwide, which is supported by recycling and papermaking operations. We play a central role in the value chain across sectors including e-commerce, fast moving consumer goods and industrials. Through our purpose of ‘Redefining Packaging for a Changing World’ and our Now and Next sustainability strategy, DS Smith is committed to leading the transition to the circular economy. We are delivering more and more circular solutions for our customers and wider society – replacing problem plastics, taking carbon out of supply chains and providing innovative recycling solutions. Our history can be traced back to the box-making businesses started in the 1940s by the Smith family. Today, DS Smith is headquartered in London and a member of the FTSE 100, operating in 34 countries employing around 30,000 people.Your future workplaceDS Smith is focusing on realizing the potential of our people every day, and you will get close to endless opportunities for independent prioritization of your day-to-day work in a good work environment with colleagues of all ages and nationalities. Like all other DS Smith colleagues, we are proud of the opportunity to make a sustainable difference in a market-leading company. But we also consider our colleagues as individuals and would like to make their lives healthier and happier, therefore we offer our colleagues a range of benefits.Fair recruitment in DS SmithDon’t meet every single requirement? At DS Smith, we are committed to recruiting across a wide range of candidates. We are thriving for being a diverse workplace where everyone can realize their potential. We see equality and diversity as a strength. Thus, we hope that you will apply for the position even if you do not necessarily meet all the requirements.Would you like to know more?This full-time position can be based at one of our sites in either Sweden or Denmark, with travels between sites to be expected. Accession as soon as possible.If you want to know more about this role, contact our Head of Procurement Leader East & North EMEA, Jeremy Freyne: jeremy.freyne@dssmith.comIf you have questions regarding the process or trouble applying, please reach out to us at nordic.recruitment@dssmith.comWe hope to receive your application as soon as possible and no later than November 29th. Please observe that we do not accept applications by email.After having submitted your application, you may be expected to perform work psychological tests as well as respond to screening questions, as part of our objective, unbiased, and largely digital process.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Försöksledare/Parkchef
description: Enheten för skoglig fältforskningVill du ha en nyckelroll där du leder ett engagerat team och bidrar till framtidens skogsforskning? Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta utomhus i storslagen natur och vara med och utveckla banbrytande projekt inom skogliga ekosystem- och klimatfrågor.Vi söker en praktiker med forskningserfarenhet och goda ledaregenskaper som vill leda verksamheten vid Siljansfors och Jädraås försöksparker, liksom att ingå i ledningsgruppen för hela Enheten för skoglig fältforskning. Arbetet erbjuder stora möjligheter för dig som tycker om varierade arbetsuppgifter, stimuleras av utmaningar och vill bidra till boreal skogsproduktionsforskning och ekosystemforskning.Under 2024 gjorde Enheten en översyn av sin strategiska verksamhetsplan fram t.o.m. 2030, vilket resulterade i ett delvis förändrat sätt att organisera arbetet som nyss har implementerats. Tillsammans med fakultetens ambition att bredda verksamheten pågår det en successiv utökning av verksamhetsuppdraget. Det ställer krav på en enhetsgemensam och funktionell organisation med utgångspunkt från verksamhetens huvudområden långtidsförsök, större infrastrukturer, uppdragsprojekt respektive miljöanalys.Om jobbetDu ingår i Enhetens ledningsgrupp och som parkchef för Siljansfors och Jädraås försöksparker har du ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten inom det egna ansvarsområdet (Svealand och södra Norrland), vilket omfattar ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten och personalansvar inklusive arbetsmiljöfrågor. Din uppgift är att se till att parkens verksamhet, inom givna ekonomiska ramar, utvecklas på ett gynnsamt sätt för fältforskning, miljöövervakning och undervisning. SLU-intern samverkan och samverkan med det omgivande samhället är också områden som en parkchef kontinuerligt arbetar med.Arbetet som parkchef innebär att du tillsammans med dina medarbetare ser till att aktuella skogliga fältförsök underhålls och revideras enligt plan och med hjälp av modern teknik, samt att nya försök för framtida forskningsfrågor anläggs redan idag. Du ansvarar för innehållet i metadatabaser och databaser kopplade till dem. Som parkchef ansvarar du för att försöksparkens team aktivt deltar i styrgrupperna för verksamhetens olika huvudområden och att de arbetsuppgifter som grupperna beslutar om implementeras inom ditt ansvarsområde. Att ta emot förfrågningar och i möjligaste mån genomföra dem, gällande anläggning eller revision av skogliga fältförsök, miljöövervakningsuppdrag, liksom undervisnings- och fortbildningsuppdrag, är en viktig del av arbetet.Under barmarksperioden kommer du att medverka i praktiskt arbete, vilket innebär en hel del utomhusvistelse och resande under kortare perioder.Din bakgrund Krav:    Högre skoglig utbildning, med forskarutbildning eller annan relevant erfarenhet av akademiskt arbete med god insikt i forskningens förutsättningar    Stor erfarenhet av praktiskt fältarbete i skogliga miljöer    God förmåga att strukturera arbetet och kan agera både pedagogiskt och diplomatiskt    B-körkort för bil    God kunskap i det svenska och engelska språketKvalifikationer som är meriterande:    Chefserfarenhet med personalansvar    Erfarenhet av praktiskt skogsbruk och skoglig inventering    Erfarenhet av databasarbete, GIS-data och relaterad mjukvara    Insatt i metodik och teknik för trädmätning och fältdatainsamling    Erfarenhet av meteorologiska instrument och dataloggrarVi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Av särskilt stor betydelse är förmågan att hantera oväntade situationer, t.ex. när nya arbetsuppgifter ska utföras med kort varsel. Tjänsten är placerad vid Siljansfors försöksparks kontor inne i Mora och vid fältstationen i Siljansfors, 18 km SV om Mora. Fakulteten för skogsvetenskap vid SLU finns i Umeå.Om tjänsten: Din tjänstetitel är försöksledare, där uppdraget som parkchef ingår. Överlämningen av detta uppdrag sker vid en tidpunkt som du, nuvarande parkchef och enhetsföreståndaren kommer överens omOm ossSLU disponerar åtta skogliga försöksparker i olika delar av Sverige. Försöksparkerna utgör tillsammans Enheten för skoglig fältforskning som ansvarar för SLU:s skogliga fältforskningsinfrastruktur, i vilken det även ingår ett stort antal långsiktiga fältförsök lokaliserade hos olika markvärdar utanför parkgränserna. Siljansfors försökspark är belägen ca 18 km SV om Mora i Dalarnas län och innefattar 1600 hektar skogsmark, Jädraås försökspark är belägen ca 40 km norr om Sandviken i Gävleborgs län. Flera nationella och internationella forsknings- och miljöövervakningsprojekt har förlagt infrastruktur och mätprogram på en eller flera av enhetens försöksparker.Mer information om enheten: https://www.slu.se/om-slu/organisation/institutioner/skoglig-faltforskning/ Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba vid SLU på https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Placering:Siljansfors försöksparkAnställningsform:Tillsvidareanställning. SLU kan komma att tillämpa provanställning.Omfattning:100%Tillträde:1 februari eller enligt överenskommelse.Ansökan:Välkommen med din ansökan via ansökningsknappen nedan senast 2026-12-21Den 20–22 november går det inte att skicka in ansökningar via rekryteringssystemet på grund av en systemuppdatering.Fackliga kontaktpersoner:https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersoner/ Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) har en nyckelroll i utvecklingen för hållbart liv, grundad i vetenskap och utbildning. Genom vårt fokus på samspelen mellan människa, djur och ekosystem och ett ansvarsfullt brukande av naturresurserna bidrar vi till en hållbar samhällsutveckling och goda livsvillkor på vår planet. Huvudorter är Alnarp, Umeå och Uppsala, men verksamhet bedrivs också på forskningsstationer, försöksparker och utbildningsorter i hela landet. SLU har drygt 4000 medarbetare, 6000 studenter och forskarstuderande och en omsättning på över 4,5 miljarder kronor. Universitetet satsar på attraktiva miljöer på sina campusområden. Vi arbetar för en jämställd och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika erfarenheter lägger grunden för vetenskaplighet, kreativitet och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och perspektiv att söka den aktuella anställningen.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Company DescriptionEveryone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.But where does that take you?To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.Job DescriptionWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in StockholmIn this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.On a daily basis you will    Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.    Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.    Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.    Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.    Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.    Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.QualificationsYou will be a strong fit if you have    At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.     Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.    Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.    Solid knowledge of application and information security.    Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.    Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.    Openness to participating in on-call rotations.    Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.As a person you are    Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.    Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.    Fluent in English.    Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback. Additional InformationDisclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address. Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.Recruiting-Platform powered by SmartRecruiters.

title: Postdoc in Environmental Change
description: We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application! Are you interested in the potential of citizens' assemblies and other democratic innovations to drive climate transformation? Come join us!Work assignments The Environmental Change division (tema Miljöförändring) at the Department of Thematic Studies is looking to hire a two-year postdoctoral researcher specializing in democratic innovations.You will be part of the Formas-funded research project Democratic Innovations for Climate Transformation (2027-2029), which entails a systematic and interdisciplinary knowledge synthesis of how climate citizens’ assemblies and related democratic processes can contribute to system transformation. The project explores what the existing research literature tells us about the political impact of climate assemblies, how they might contribute to broader systemic transformations, and what this means for Swedish climate governance.As postdoc on the project, you will take a leading role in carrying out the systematic literature review across academic databases and grey literature, following established standards for searching, screening, and quality assessment. You will contribute centrally to the comparative synthesis of findings across studies, and to identifying evidence gaps in how deliberative processes connect to system-level transformation. You will also help design and facilitate stakeholder dialogues with Swedish municipalities and practitioners, which ensures that the resulting knowledge is robust and genuinely useful for policy and practice.You will work in close collaboration with the project’s principal investigator and a research team from LiU and Stockholm Resilience Centre. There is considerable room to help shape the project’s methodological choices and analytical framework, and to co-author academic outputs arising from the review and synthesis work.As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.QualificationsTo be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.Your doctoral degree should preferably have been awarded no more than three years ago. If there are special reasons, a degree awarded more than three years ago may be accepted. Special reasons include sick leave, parental leave, trade union positions of trust, service in the defense, or other similar circumstances, as well as service or assignments relevant to the subject area.We are looking for someone with a doctoral degree in social sciences, humanities, or related fields, and a demonstrated familiarity with the research area of democratic innovations – for example, deliberative democracy, citizens’ assemblies, participatory governance, or environmental/climate governance. Experience carrying out systematic literature reviews and others forms of qualitative content analysis is considered a merit. So is prior experience with stakeholder involvement and co-production through workshops and similar formats.You are curious, rigorous, and comfortable moving between the fine-grained work of systematic screening and coding and the bigger-picture task of synthesizing what it all means. You enjoy working collaboratively, taking initiative, and are able to communicate complex research to non-academic audiences, such as policymakers and practitioners. A strong command of written and spoken English is required.The workplaceYou will be employed at the Department of Thematic Studies where you will be affiliated with the Environmental Change theme. You can read about the workplace https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/tema/temam.The employmentThis employment is a temporary full-time contract of two years. Starting date is Januari 1, 2027, or as soon as possible. Salary and employment benefitsAt Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.Union representativesInformation about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.Application procedureApply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 27 November, 2026.Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University. In the event of a discrepancy between the English translation of the job announcement and the Swedish original, the Swedish version shall take precedent. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. title: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
description: Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:    Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.    Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.    Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.Required qualificationsThe position requires:    PhD in Biology or Bioengineering    Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories    At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal     Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels    Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification    Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.    Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D    Experience in microfluidics and microscopy    Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD    Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).Merits include:    Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation    Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.    Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software    Experience as executive member of scientific societies Terms of employmentThis is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.Application instructionsYour application should include:    A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans    A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors    A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)    A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)We warmly welcome your application!Mer om Medicinska fakultetenMedicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

title: PhD Student in Urban Water Engineering
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.The Urban Water Engineering research group at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural resources engineering at Luleå University of Technology seeks a driven and committed PhD student to investigate how smart monitoring and predictive modelling can support more effective and environmentally sustainable maintenance of urban drainage infrastructure. The research focuses on understanding sediment accumulation through sensor-based monitoring and data analysis, contributing to improved water quality and urban flood resilience. More information on http://www.ltu.se/waterSubject descriptionUrban Water Engineering encompasses the entire urban water system (storm drains, drinking water supply and wastewater) with respect to collection, transport and treatment, as well as organisation and planning. The research aims to encourage a strong economy, clean environment and the wise use of resources, while preserving the public’s health and safety.Project descriptionStormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.The PhD research will focus on developing a data-driven understanding of sediment accumulation processes in urban drainage infrastructures. This includes long-term monitoring using high-resolution sensors to capture sediment dynamics across rainfall events and seasons. Based on these data, predictive models will be developed to estimate sediment accumulation and infrastructure’s remaining functionality. The results will support more effective maintenance strategies by identifying when and where maintenances are needed to maximise environmental performance and operational efficiency.Within this project, the doctoral student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in the water and wastewater industry and will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers through LTU's well-established competence network.DutiesAs a PhD student, you will perform both experimental and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse scientific data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work. The research work for this project will specifically include experimental work.QualificationsWe seek a candidate with an MSc degree or equivalent or fully completed course requirements of at least 240 ETCS of which at least 60 ETCS are at an advanced level or equivalent. The degree should be within the field of water and environment, environmental engineering, natural resources engineering, civil engineering, or equivalent. Specific knowledge of stormwater management, hydraulics/hydrology, statistics, machine learning, thermodynamics (e.g. heat transfer processes) and programming, as well as experience of sensor-based monitoring, are meritorious. Other important skills are the ability to work independently and take initiative, as well as being able to explore new research areas.English language skills are required since the results will be presented internationally in scientific journals and at conferences. Swedish/Scandinavian language skills are beneficial, as they will facilitate communication with stakeholders and participation in teaching activities. Having a driver’s license is meritorious, as it will facilitate research work.Applicants should provide contact details to minimum two reference persons upon request.For further information about a specific subject see:* http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=enFurther informationEmployment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added to that time with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: Spring 2027.For each position, a preliminary is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role. https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-InformationonpaytransparencyFor further information about the position, please contact Postdoctoral researcherHaoyu Wei, 0920-491728, haoyu.wei@ltu.seUnion representatives: https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-TradeunioncontactsIn case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.ApplicationWe prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.Closing date for applications: 30 November 2026Reference number: 5719-2026

description: Location: Primarily based in Genolier, Switzerland, with occasional travel to the United Kingdom (approximately 5 to 10 days per calendar year, based on current information).Working schedule: Rotational shifts of approximately 14–16 daysWorking environment: Private householdConsistent Care Team provisionThe Care Team shall ultimately comprise 3 members of staff: 1 Registered Nurse and 2 Health Care Assistants/Carers.The Registered Nurse will have day-to-day oversight of the Care Team and clinical decision making and assessment delegating tasks and roles to the 2-care staff, one member of the team shall be allocated to care of the principal. collaborations avec les médecins spécialistes, les cliniques du groupe Swiss Medical Network et les partenaires externes.  Contribuer à la création de nouvelles prestations et parcours de soins innovants.  Promouvoir l'image et le positionnement de MotionLab dans la région.  Participer à des projets institutionnels visant à renforcer la qualité, l'efficience et la croissance de l'activité.  Qualité et innovation  Définir et faire évoluer les protocoles, standards et recommandations de prise en charge.  Garantir la qualité et la cohérence des traitements délivrés par Nous sommes chez nous dans toute l'Europe et toujours près de chez vous.  Product Owner stratégique \- Transformation métier et pilotage (f/m/d)========================================================================Be your best with bechtle-------------------------Pour le compte de notre client basé à Genève, nous recherchons un Product Owner stratégique \- Transformation métier et pilotage (f/m/d) chargé de transformer les orientations métier et la feuille de route du système d'information en initiatives concrètes, d'en structurer le pilotage et de garantir leur cohérence avec les besoins des métiers et l'évolution du système d'information. **Ta mission*** Analyser les stratégies métier, les besoins des différentes entités et la feuille de route SI afin d'identifier les transformations prioritaires et les bénéfices attendus.* Traduire ces orientations en projets, actions et priorités concrètes, contribuer au cadrage des mandats de projet et définir les travaux à confier aux différentes parties prenantes.* Organiser le suivi de la feuille de route SI en structurant les roadmaps, jalons, responsabilités, dépendances et risques, et proposer des mesures correctives lorsque la trajectoire définie est compromise.* Anticiper dès la phase de cadrage les besoins liés à la maintenance, à l'évolutivité et à la future exploitation des solutions afin d'assurer leur pérennité et leur valeur dans la durée.* Fédérer les métiers, architectes, chefs de projet, gestionnaires de service et autres contributeurs afin d'assurer l'alignement entre les orientations stratégiques et leur mise en oeuvre opérationnelle.Ton profil----------* Expérience confirmée, idéalement de 7 à 10 ans, en Product Ownership, Business Analyse stratégique, transformation métier ou pilotage de projets et programmes complexes.* Capacité démontrée à comprendre des enjeux métier et stratégiques, puis à les traduire en priorités, roadmaps, mandats, livrables et actions concrètes.* Solide maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de projet et de gouvernance ; capacité à s'approprier rapidement un cadre méthodologique structuré. Des connaissances en architecture d'entreprise et/ou de TOGAF sont attendues.* Excellentes capacités de communication et d'influence, avec l'aptitude à créer un réseau transversal et à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs jusqu'au niveau des directions, sans lien hiérarchique direct.* Autonomie, curiosité, capacité d'analyse et pragmatisme, avec une réelle aisance dans des environnements complexes, transverses et en évolution.* Bonne compréhension des enjeux de transformation numérique, de gouvernance des données, de prestations en ligne et de simplification des parcours utilisateurs. **Notre proposition** * Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif* Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle*   Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenirNuméro d'emploi : YBOKK566  Brosse \| \|  Bechtle Suisse SA-----------------Bechtle Suisse SA dispose de compétences certifiées dans les domaines stratégiques : Infrastructure IT, Virtualisation, Information Management, Managed Services, Skills Management, Data\& Analytics, Printing Solutions et E\-Commerce. Grâce à ces compétences et à de solides et durables partenariats avec les principaux acteurs du marché, nous proposons une gamme modulaire et parfaitement cohérente de produits et de services pour couvrir l'ensemble des besoins de nos clients.  Notre proximité, notre vision globale de l'infrastructure et de la gestion de projets font de nous un acteur incontournable du marché. Mit Professionalität, Fachkompetenz und echtem Gespür für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundschaft sorgen wir dafür, dass jede Anfrage schnell, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert beantwortet wird. **Das bietet dir die Stelle*** Du bist täglich nah an unserer Kundschaft, telefonisch wie schriftlich. Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, echte Wirkung zu erzielen: Mit einem offenen Ohr, raschen Lösungen und einer persönlichen Note sorgst du dafür, dass sich unsere Kundschaft von Anfang an in guten Händen weiss* Du übernimmst eine zentrale koordinierende und gestaltest den Servicealltag aktiv mit. Du stimmst Termine mit der Kundschaft ab und planst die Einsätze und Tagestouren unserer Servicetechnikerinnen und Servicetechniker. Du informierst proaktiv über Reparaturtermine und Montagen und schaffst damit Vertrauen, auch wenn noch keine definitive Lösung vorliegt* Du behältst in einem vielseitigen Alltag den Überblick. Pendente Aufträge und Statuslisten geben dir jederzeit ein klares Bild der und den Handlungsspielraum, dort anzupacken, wo es zählt **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit*** Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und bringst einige Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit mit. Ob Disposition, Contact Center oder Kundendienst, du kennst das Geschäft und weisst, worauf es ankommt* Im Kontakt mit der Kundschaft läufst du zur Hochform auf. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique --- Technicien de maintenance électromécanique ============================================ \*\*Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro\\-fabrication médicale\*\* --------------------------------------------------------------- Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro\\-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d'innover et d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde. Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité. Nous recherchons un \*\*technicien de maintenance électromécanique\*\* prêt à jouer un rôle clé dans la fiabilité et la performance de nos équipements, tout en assurant leur bon fonctionnement et en accompagnant nos équipes de production au quotidien. \*\*Mission\*\* ----------- Au sein de l'équipe de la Maintenance, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements de production afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur fiabilité et leur performance. Vous participez à l'ensemble des activités du service maintenance tout en apportant une expertise particulière en électricité industrielle et en diagnostic de pannes. \*\*Vos principales responsabilités\*\* ------------------------------------ \* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements de production. \* Diagnostiquer et dépanner les pannes électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et électromécaniques. \* Assurer la remise en service des équipements dans le respect des exigences sécurité, qualité et production. \* Participer à la mise à jour de la documentation technique et des schémas électriques. \* Identifier les composants défectueux ou obsolètes et rechercher des solutions de remplacement adaptées. \* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et accompagner les prestataires externes lors de leurs interventions. \* Participer aux actions d'amélioration continue visant à améliorer la fiabilité des équipements et à réduire les temps d'arrêt. \* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions dans la GMAO. \*\*Votre profil\*\* ---------------- \* CFC d'Automaticien ou formation technique équivalente avec expérience en maintenance industrielle. \* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (ISO 13485 ou équivalent). \* Expérience du dépannage et de la maintenance sur des équipements industriels variés, y compris des équipements anciens. \* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit. \* Solides connaissances en électricité industrielle et bonnes connaissances en mécanique industrielle et pneumatique. \* Connaissance d'une GMAO. \* Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques et du diagnostic de pannes. \* Connaissances en automates industriels et interfaces opérateur constituant un atout. \* Autorisation OIBT art. 13 ou 15 constituant un atout. \* Personne autonome et pragmatique, dotée d'un fort esprit de terrain et d'une approche orientée vers la recherche de solutions concrètes. \*\*Ce que nous vous offrons\*\* ---------------------------- \* Un environnement industriel de haute précision, technologiquement exigeant et stimulant. \* Une forte proximité avec la production, l'ingénierie et les clients. \* Une équipe engagée et collaborative. \* Des projets variés et des interactions avec des clients et équipes internationales. \* L'opportunité de contribuer concrètement à l'amélioration et à la transformation de nos processus qualité. \* Des possibilités de développement professionnel au sein d'un groupe international en croissance. Chez Resonetics, nous valorisons l'excellence, l'engagement et l'esprit d'équipe. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets innovants dans un environnement dynamique, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. \*Le masculin est utilisé pour alléger le texte et inclut le féminin.\* !\[Resonetics SA\]( ) \* Resonetics SA Route de Chardonne 4 1070 Puidoux \* \[ \](\< \>) jpidb615bb6jm jpit1041jm jpiy26jm

Vous assurez ensuite la production, les cuissons minute, le dressage, le réassort et les envois du petit\-déjeuner, en veillant à maintenir la même qualité et la même fraîcheur pour chaque client tout au long du service. Vous préparez également les commandes minute avec précision et adaptez les préparations aux éventuelles allergies ou régimes alimentaires communiqués.Après le service, vous assurez le repli, le tri et le suivi des invendus ainsi que leur remise en froid dans le respect des normes d'hygiène. Vous anticipez les besoins du lendemain, gérez les commandes et signalez les éventuelles ruptures avant la fin de votre service. Vous veillez également à maintenir votre poste de travail, les équipements et les réserves propres, organisés et conformes aux exigences d'hygiène, de traçabilité et de sécurité alimentaire.Une attention particulière est portée à la gestion responsable des produits. Vous contrôlez leur fraîcheur, leurs dates, leur étiquetage et leur rotation et contribuez activement à limiter le gaspillage grâce à une production adaptée et à un suivi rigoureux des invendus. Vous valorisez autant que possible les produits locaux et les préparations maison, en cohérence avec l'identité culinaire de l'établissement. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de salle afin de garantir un service fluide, attentif et efficace.Profil recherché-----------------Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC de cuisinier, d'une formation professionnelle équivalente ou disposez d'une expérience confirmée en cuisine. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de mise en place, les cuissons minute, le dressage et la gestion d'un buffet et disposez de solides connaissances en matière d'hygiène alimentaire.Autonome, organisé et rigoureux, vous savez anticiper les volumes et gérer efficacement votre poste dès les premières heures de la journée. Vous êtes particulièrement attentif aux allergies, aux régimes alimentaires et aux risques de contamination croisée. Vous appréciez le travail bien fait et êtes capable de rester calme et efficace durant les périodes de forte activité.Orienté client, vous avez à cœur de proposer une prestation de qualité et de porter une attention particulière aux détails. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer efficacement avec la salle et les différents interlocuteurs de l'établissement. Une expérience dans un hôtel ou établissement haut de gamme, une connaissance des produits du terroir valaisan ou une formation complémentaire en hygiène alimentaire, pâtisserie ou nutrition constituent des atouts supplémentaires. La maîtrise du français est indispensable et de bonnes connaissances en anglais représentent un avantage.#### **NOUS VOUS OFFRONS**Nous vous proposons un poste à 60% au sein d'un établissement haut de gamme à taille humaine, dans un cadre exceptionnel au cœur d'Évolène. Vous rejoindrez une cuisine où la qualité des produits, la simplicité, l'authenticité et la durabilité occupent une place centrale.Le poste implique une prise de service matinale, ainsi que des disponibilités certains week\-ends et jours fériés selon les besoins de l'exploitation.Vous souhaitez rejoindre un projet où votre autonomie, votre savoir\-faire et votre sens du détail peuvent réellement faire la différence ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.Afin de faciliter la lecture, cette offre d'emploi est rédigée au masculin, mais s'adresse bien entendu à toute personne correspondant au profil recherché, sans distinction de genre.Depuis 2008, Hotelis accompagne les professionnels de l'hôtellerie, de la restauration et de l'événementiel dans leurs enjeux liés au recrutement et au placement de personnel qualifié. Au travers d'Hotelis Executive, sa division spécialisée dans les fonctions d'encadrement et de direction, Hotelis intervient sur des recrutements stratégiques en s'appuyant sur une expertise sectorielle reconnue ainsi qu'une approche directe et ciblée des meilleurs talents du marché.jpid50f315ajm jpit1041jm jpiy26jm

Domänen und identifizierst gemeinsam mit dem Business Handlungsfelder, Abhängigkeiten und Veränderungsbedarf.* Du verknüpfst Business Capabilities und Value Streams mit strategischen Initiativen und dem Portfolio und unterstützt damit eine nachvollziehbare Priorisierung von Veränderungen und Investitionen.* Du bringst die Business\-Architecture\-Perspektive in strategisch relevante Initiativen ein und stellst sicher, dass geplante Veränderungen mit den definierten Business\-Zielbildern übereinstimmen.* Du arbeitest eng mit Business\-Verantwortlichen, Enterprise und Domain Architecture,
